test_sequential_learn
TestLearn
Test user should be able to create course with delivery mode==sequential
Test user should be able to add a chapter to a course whose delivery mode is sequential
Test user should be able to upload new content into the system
Test user should be able to publish the uploaded document
Test user should be able to add content to chapter.
Test user should be able to publish the course whose delivery mode is sequential.
Test user should be able to add course whose delivery mode is sequential to program.
Test user should be able to add course whose delivery mode is sequential to cohort.

Given a user with a sequential course assigned, when they access the learn page, then only the first content should be accessible and rest of the content should be locked and shown one after the another on completion of previous content

Given when contents are reordered within a chapter belonging to a course whose delivery mode is sequential from coaches portalThen the order of contents should be updated accordingly and sequential access should be maintained within the user portal

Given when chapters are reordered within a course whose delivery mode is sequential from coaches portalThen the order of chapters should be updated accordingly and sequential access should be maintained within the user portal

Given when multiple chapters are accessed within a course whose delivery mode is sequential from coaches portalThen the order of chapters should be updated accordingly and sequential access should be maintained within the user portal

Given access unlocks after the first content is accessed within a course whose delivery mode is sequential from coaches portalThen all subsequent chapters and contents should be unlocked for access within the user portal

Given a course is created with sequential delivery mode from coaches portalThen the course structure should reflect the sequential access requirements under course module in coaches portal for that cohort
Given when user access a sequentially delivered course from user portalthen when coach should see the user's progress in coaches portal for that user
